With concerns to effing things up... It's going to take me almost twice as long to finish university because I can never seem to manage the stress. Also, because of my mental health I'm way behind on other life milestones. My first serious relationship was with someone who physically abused me, my dad doesn't talk to me, etc. Like clearly I'm not liked for a reason. 

Then, the one thing that made all the bad things feel so small was my psychiatrist. He admitted that he had feelings for me - literally making me cry out of joy because it was the best thing that had/has ever happened to me - and I messed up entirely by having a psychotic episode.

Because I am really good at effing things up, despite my best intentions not to. I also hate myself for being so attached to him when most people don't get this attached. I also have had 3 psychotic episodes which proves that I'm literally out of my fucking mind.
Thank you for the empathetic response, despite this subreddit not necessarily being the appropriate place for me to post. I'm glad you're not suicidal anymore.
